cat > build.py <<'PY'
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
import numpy as np
import json
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation

def make(smiles,seed):
 m=Chem.AddHs(Chem.MolFromSmiles(smiles))
 assert AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,randomSeed=seed)==0
 AllChem.UFFOptimizeMolecule(m,maxIters=2000)
 p=np.array(m.GetConformer().GetPositions())
 return m,p

# rotate a fragment so specified vectors match targets, then translate anchor
# specified vectors from anchor to target atoms

def place(m,p,anchor,indices,targets,dest):
 a=p[anchor].copy(); V=p[indices]-a
 V=V/np.linalg.norm(V,axis=1)[:,None]
 T=np.array(targets,dtype=float);T/=np.linalg.norm(T,axis=1)[:,None]
 r,err=Rotation.align_vectors(T,V)
 return r.apply(p-a)+np.array(dest)

atoms=[];coords=[]; bonds=[]; groups={}
def append(m,p,name,exclude=[]):
 ids={}
 for a in m.GetAtoms():
  i=a.GetIdx()
  if i in exclude:continue
  ids[i]=len(atoms);atoms.append(a.GetSymbol()); coords.append(p[i])
 for b in m.GetBonds():
  i,j=b.GetBeginAtomIdx(),b.GetEndAtomIdx()
  if i in ids and j in ids:bonds.append([ids[i],ids[j],b.GetBondTypeAsDouble()])
 groups[name]=ids
 return ids

# Quinoline oxysilyl ligand; methyl cap occupies the Rh coordination position.
m,q=make('Cc1cccc2c1nc(O[SiH2]C)cc2C',731)
for a in m.GetAtoms():
 print('Q',a.GetIdx(),a.GetSymbol(),[n.GetIdx() for n in a.GetNeighbors()])
si=10; cap=11; o=9
q=place(m,q,si,[cap,o],[[1,0,0],[-0.38,0.92,0]],[-2.35,0,0])
# turn around Si--Rh axis so ligand is above-left, in the XY plane
exc=[cap]+[a.GetIdx() for a in m.GetAtomWithIdx(cap).GetNeighbors() if a.GetSymbol()=='H']
qi=append(m,q,'quin',exc)
# Rh and two hydrides in equatorial plane
rh=len(atoms);atoms.append('Rh');coords.append([0,0,0])
h1=len(atoms);atoms.append('H');coords.append([0.83,0,1.438])
h2=len(atoms);atoms.append('H');coords.append([0.83,0,-1.438])
bonds += [[rh,qi[si],1],[rh,h1,1],[rh,h2,1]]
# axial pyrrolidine: N lone pair points toward metal; N-H points toward left, towards sulfonyl O
m,n=make('C1CCNC1',302)
N=3; nh=[a.GetIdx() for a in m.GetAtomWithIdx(N).GetNeighbors() if a.GetSymbol()=='H'][0]
cs=[a.GetIdx() for a in m.GetAtomWithIdx(N).GetNeighbors() if a.GetSymbol()=='C']
# infer fourth tetrahedral vector opposite sum of bond vectors
v=n[[nh]+cs]-n[N];v/=np.linalg.norm(v,axis=1)[:,None]
lone=-v.sum(axis=0);lone/=np.linalg.norm(lone)
V=np.array([lone,v[0]])
T=np.array([[0,-1,0],[-0.87,-0.333,0.364]])
r,e=Rotation.align_vectors(T,V)
n=r.apply(n-n[N])+[0,2.20,0]
ni=append(m,n,'pyrrolidine');bonds.append([rh,ni[N],1])
# phosphine
m,p=make('P(C1CCCCC1)(C1CCCCC1)C1CCCCC1',929)
P=0; cs=[a.GetIdx() for a in m.GetAtomWithIdx(P).GetNeighbors()]
v=p[cs]-p[P];v/=np.linalg.norm(v,axis=1)[:,None]
lone=-v.sum(axis=0);lone/=np.linalg.norm(lone)
r,e=Rotation.align_vectors(np.array([[0,1,0],[0.8,-0.5,-0.3]]),np.array([lone,v[0]]))
p=r.apply(p-p[P])+[0,-2.32,0]
pi=append(m,p,'phosphine');bonds.append([rh,pi[P],1])
# methyl(dimethoxy)silyl triflate
m,t=make('CO[Si](C)(OC)OS(=O)(=O)C(F)(F)F',834)
for a in m.GetAtoms():print('T',a.GetIdx(),a.GetSymbol(),[n.GetIdx() for n in a.GetNeighbors()])
# sulfonyl O at 8 to interact with pyrrolidine N-H
# ester O 6 near the forward metal hydride
# initial seed orientation determined by these two sites
anchor=8
nH=np.array(coords[ni[nh]]);hpos=np.array(coords[h1])
# final points for O(sulfonyl) and OSi obtained roughly to accommodate both contacts
A=nH+np.array([-1.65,-1.0,0.65])
B=hpos+np.array([-0.7,-0.85,1.85])
# align O8->O6 and S orientation to keep spectator on front/left of metal
v1=t[6]-t[8]; v2=t[7]-t[8]
w1=B-A; w2=np.array([-0.4,-1.2,0.6])
r,e=Rotation.align_vectors(np.array([w1/np.linalg.norm(w1),w2/np.linalg.norm(w2)]),np.array([v1/np.linalg.norm(v1),v2/np.linalg.norm(v2)]))
t=r.apply(t-t[8])+A
ti=append(m,t,'triflate_silane')
coords=np.array(coords)
with open('initial.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{len(atoms)}\nRh silyl dihydride pyrrolidine PCy3 complex with methyl dimethoxy silyl triflate\n')
 for a,c in zip(atoms,coords): f.write(f'{a} {c[0]:.8f} {c[1]:.8f} {c[2]:.8f}\n')
meta={'atoms':atoms,'groups':groups,'bonds':bonds,'rh':rh,'h1':h1,'h2':h2,'silyl':qi[si],'N':ni[N],'NH':ni[nh],'P':pi[P],'tfO':ti[8],'esterO':ti[6]}
json.dump(meta,open('meta.json','w'),indent=2)
print('Meta', {k:v for k,v in meta.items() if k not in ['atoms','groups','bonds']})
print('NH pos',nH,'O8',t[8],'H1',hpos,'O6',t[6])
PY

cat > preopt.py <<'PY'
import numpy as np, json
from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
from scipy.optimize import minimize
from scipy.spatial.distance import cdist
meta=json.load(open('meta.json')); atoms=meta['atoms']; bonds=meta['bonds'];groups=meta['groups']
coords=np.array([list(map(float,l.split()[1:])) for l in open('initial.xyz').readlines()[2:]])
frags=[];groupidx=np.full(len(atoms),-1)
for n,(name,d) in enumerate(groups.items()):
 inds=np.array(list(d.values())); idx={v:i for i,v in enumerate(inds)}
 rw=Chem.RWMol()
 for i in inds:
  a=Chem.Atom(atoms[i]);a.SetNoImplicit(True);rw.AddAtom(a)
 for i,j,bo in bonds:
  if i in idx and j in idx:
   bt={1:Chem.BondType.SINGLE,2:Chem.BondType.DOUBLE,1.5:Chem.BondType.AROMATIC}[bo]
   rw.AddBond(idx[i],idx[j],bt)
 m=rw.GetMol();Chem.SanitizeMol(m)
 cf=Chem.Conformer(len(inds))
 for i,p in enumerate(coords[inds]):cf.SetAtomPosition(i,p)
 m.AddConformer(cf)
 ff=AllChem.UFFGetMoleculeForceField(m)
 frags.append((inds,ff));groupidx[inds]=n
# singletons Rh/hydrides
for i in [meta['rh'],meta['h1'],meta['h2']]: groupidx[i]=groupidx.max()+1
vdw={'H':1.2,'C':1.7,'N':1.55,'O':1.52,'F':1.47,'S':1.8,'P':1.8,'Si':2.1,'Rh':1.8}
radii=np.array([vdw[a] for a in atoms])
# atom pairs across fragments
I,J=np.triu_indices(len(atoms),1)
mask=groupidx[I]!=groupidx[J]
I=I[mask];J=J[mask]
rh,N,P,si,h1,h2,NH,Ot,OE=[meta[k] for k in ['rh','N','P','silyl','h1','h2','NH','tfO','esterO']]
excluded=set(tuple(sorted([rh,i])) for i in [N,P,si,h1,h2])
excluded|={tuple(sorted([NH,Ot])),tuple(sorted([h1,OE]))}
mask=np.array([tuple([i,j]) not in excluded for i,j in zip(I,J)])
I=I[mask];J=J[mask]
cut=0.85*(radii[I]+radii[J])
dconstraints=[(rh,N,2.2,160),(rh,P,2.32,180),(rh,si,2.35,180),(rh,h1,1.65,220),(rh,h2,1.65,220),(NH,Ot,1.9,40),(h1,OE,2.2,20)]
aconstraints=[(N,rh,P,-1,120),(si,rh,h1,-0.5,140),(si,rh,h2,-0.5,140),(h1,rh,h2,-0.5,140),(N,rh,si,0,120),(N,rh,h1,0,120),(N,rh,h2,0,120),(N,NH,Ot,-0.96,25)]

def calc(flat):
 q=flat.reshape(-1,3);g=np.zeros_like(q);e=0
 for inds,ff in frags:
  pos=q[inds].ravel().tolist(); e+=ff.CalcEnergy(pos);g[inds]+=np.array(ff.CalcGrad(pos)).reshape(-1,3)
 delta=q[I]-q[J]; dist=np.linalg.norm(delta,axis=1); violation=np.minimum(dist-cut,0)
 k=45
 e+=k*np.sum(violation**2)
 gg=(2*k*violation/np.maximum(dist,1e-8))[:,None]*delta
 np.add.at(g,I,gg);np.add.at(g,J,-gg)
 for a,b,t,k in dconstraints:
  v=q[a]-q[b];d=np.linalg.norm(v);dif=d-t
  e+=k*dif*dif;gg=2*k*dif*v/d;g[a]+=gg;g[b]-=gg
 for a,b,c,t,k in aconstraints:
  v=q[a]-q[b];w=q[c]-q[b];lv=np.linalg.norm(v);lw=np.linalg.norm(w)
  v/=lv;w/=lw;cos=v@w; dif=cos-t
  e+=k*dif*dif
  ga=2*k*dif*(w-cos*v)/lv;gc=2*k*dif*(v-cos*w)/lw
  g[a]+=ga;g[c]+=gc;g[b]-=ga+gc
 # constrain Rh anchor for convenience
 e+=100*np.sum(q[rh]**2);g[rh]+=200*q[rh]
 return e,g.ravel()
print('Initial E',calc(coords.ravel())[0],flush=True)
count=0
def cb(q):
 global count
 count+=1
 if count%100==0:print('Iter',count,'E',calc(q)[0],flush=True)
res=minimize(calc,coords.ravel(),jac=True,method='L-BFGS-B',callback=cb,options={'maxiter':3000,'ftol':1e-11,'gtol':1e-4,'maxls':60})
print(res.message,res.fun,np.max(np.abs(res.jac)))
q=res.x.reshape(-1,3)
with open('preopt.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{len(atoms)}\nPreoptimized depicted Rh complex\n')
 for a,p in zip(atoms,q):f.write(f'{a} {p[0]:.8f} {p[1]:.8f} {p[2]:.8f}\n')
print('Constraints')
for a,b,t,k in dconstraints:print(a,b,t,np.linalg.norm(q[a]-q[b]))
D=cdist(q,q)
bondset={tuple(sorted(b[:2])) for b in bonds}
for i,j in zip(*np.where(np.triu(D<1.3,1))):
 if (i,j) not in bondset:print('Short',i,atoms[i],j,atoms[j],D[i,j])
